target.title: fix(exec): validate script files outside the workspace root for shell bleed
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
When validation of script files for shell bleed was performed during exec preflight checks, scripts located outside the workspace root (e.g. absolute paths or relative paths resolving to parent directories) had `relativePath` return `null`, causing the check loop to silently skip them. This bypassed the shell bleed variable injection controls.

This PR ensures that scripts outside the workspace root are resolved and read using their absolute path for validation, rather than skipped entirely.

## Evidence
Passed tests on branch `fix/4.1-script-preflight-outside-workspace-validation`:
```
 ✓ |agents| src/agents/bash-tools.exec.script-preflight.test.ts (61 tests | 4 skipped) 340ms
```
